Technology showing relative strength (XLK 1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47% ABOVE TREND) while commodities exhibit a sharp 1M/1W divergence (BNO 1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03% CORRECTION) that warrants monitoring.
